title: Work on Multiple Projects with Clusters
trigger: User needs to work on two projects or branches at the same time

steps.action: Click the + in the switcher bar to create a new cluster; Home appears
In the new cluster, open or create a different project
Two cluster tabs now appear on the left of the switcher bar; click either tab to switch between them
When switching clusters, the entire layout swaps: File Explorer, File Viewer, and terminals all belong to the active cluster
Each cluster maintains its own project path, pane arrangement, and terminal tabs independently

outcome: Two clusters are open side by side with independent projects, panes, and terminals
